name: Software Engineering
description: Focuses on software design, development methodologies, programming paradigms, and software project management. Emphasizes building reliable, maintainable, and scalable software systems.

name: Data Science
description: Focuses on extracting insights from data through statistical analysis, data visualization, and data-driven decision making. Combines statistics, programming, and domain knowledge.

name: Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning
description: Focuses on building intelligent systems that can learn from data, recognize patterns, and make decisions. Covers mathematical foundations, algorithms, and AI applications.

name: Cyber Security
description: Focuses on protecting computer systems, networks, and data from security threats. Covers security principles, ethical hacking, network security, and security policy.

name: Networking & Cloud Computing
description: Focuses on computer networking, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure. Covers network design, protocols, cloud services, and system administration.

name: Database & Data Engineering
description: Focuses on designing, implementing, and managing data systems. Covers database design, data warehousing, data pipelines, and data quality.
